# Dong Chinese

> > Dong Chinese is a Mandarin learning app that teaches Chinese through thousands of real example sentences, captioned images, videos, podcasts, and songs with contextual learning methods.

Founded by Mischa Wilmers, Dong Chinese offers HSK-aligned content with features like character etymology, stroke order practice, handwriting tools, and a comprehensive language dictionary. The platform emphasizes learning Mandarin through authentic context rather than isolated vocabulary.

## Key Topics

- Mandarin Chinese learning
- HSK (Chinese proficiency test)
- Contextual learning approach
- Chinese character etymology
- Stroke order and handwriting practice
- Real example sentences
- Chinese learning app
- Language dictionary features
- Mischa Wilmers (founder)
- Chinese character education
- Mandarin education resources
- Chinese learning journey
- Product features and updates
